source_name: omediach.com – tlačové správy / marketing section
why_relevant: Slovak media-industry site that republishes bank appointment releases (confirmed items on the SLSP board appointment and a 365.bank award). Another verbatim mirror with fast indexing.

source_name: Erste Group Bank AG — Press Releases (news-media)
why_relevant: Erste Group announces Slovenska sporitelna (SLSP) CEO/CFO appointments in English at group level, typically same-day or ahead of the SLSP Slovak newsroom. Confirmed example: 11 Aug 2025 release naming Michaela Bauer CEO of Slovenska sporitelna from March 2026, succeeding Peter Krutil.

source_name: Erste Group — Investor Information / IR news feed
why_relevant: Regulated investor-information stream (quarterly results, ad-hoc, segment reporting). Slovakia is one of Erste's seven core markets and is a reported segment, so headcount, branch count (160 branches cited) and segment restructuring appear here before local comms.

source_name: Erste Group — Management Board / corporate governance page
why_relevant: Actor map anchor: group board members and their country/segment responsibilities. Changes here cascade into who signs off Slovak subsidiary appointments; useful for diffing over time.

source_name: Intesa Sanpaolo — Price sensitive press releases (Investor Relations)
why_relevant: Parent of VUB Banka (approx. 96.97% stake). Price-sensitive releases carry Danube Hub / international subsidiaries division restructurings, capital actions and results in English; historically also Slovak JV and stake announcements.

source_name: Intesa Sanpaolo — Newsroom / all news (group)
why_relevant: Non-price-sensitive group communication where subsidiary CEO profiles and interviews appear (e.g. interview with the then-new VUB Slovakia CEO Jozef Kausich). Good for confirming role scope and strategy framing behind an appointment.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank International AG — Investor Relations / ad-hoc releases
why_relevant: RBI fully consolidates Tatra banka. RBI ad-hoc releases cover management board changes and network restructuring; RBI network pages document the Slovak entity's place in group structure.

source_name: EQS News — ad-hoc announcements (Austrian/DACH issuers incl. RBI, Erste)
why_relevant: Distribution wire carrying the legally mandated ad-hoc text verbatim, machine-friendly and often indexed before the issuer site is re-crawled. Confirmed example: RBI ad-hoc appointing Kamila Makhmudova as CFO to the Management Board.

source_name: OeKB Issuer Information Center (OAM Austria)
source_subtype: officially appointed mechanism / regulated info storage
why_relevant: Austria's officially appointed mechanism (OAM) storing regulated information for Erste Group and RBI. It is the legally complete archive that feeds the Wiener Boerse ad-hoc page, so it backstops anything deleted from a corporate site.

source_name: Wiener Börse — Ad-hoc News
why_relevant: Exchange-side consolidated ad-hoc feed for ATX issuers (Erste Group, RBI). Simple to poll and gives a single chronological stream covering two of the three biggest Slovak bank owners.

source_name: KBC Group Newsroom
source_subtype: parent group newsroom / press release archive
why_relevant: KBC owns CSOB Slovakia and, since 15 Jan 2026, 365.bank (98.45% bought from J&T Finance Group for EUR 761m). KBC states the next step is a legal and operational merger of CSOB and 365.bank — the single largest driver of Slovak banking headcount, branch and leadership change in this run's window. Also announced the CSOB Leasing / Business Lease deal (closed Feb 2026) and the 2020 OTP Banka Slovensko integration.

source_name: KBC Group — Investor Relations (results, presentations, company presentations)
why_relevant: Deal-specific investor presentations (e.g. the 365.bank acquisition deck) carry integration timelines, synergy targets and implied FTE/branch consolidation for Slovakia — the leading indicator for redundancies and hiring freezes at CSOB SK.

source_name: GlobeNewswire / Nasdaq — KBC Group regulated releases
why_relevant: KBC disseminates regulated information via GlobeNewswire/Nasdaq; these mirrors are timestamped, stable and easy to poll, and survive newsroom restructures.

source_name: UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia — Debt Investor Relations
why_relevant: The Slovak UniCredit business is a foreign-bank branch of the Prague-domiciled entity, so its governance, board and organisational disclosures live in Czech/English at unicreditbank.cz, NOT on a Slovak IR page. Prospectuses and annual reports name board members and describe the Slovak branch organisation.

source_name: UniCredit S.p.A. — Group media/IR
why_relevant: Ultimate parent; group-level CEE reorganisations, country-manager appointments and cost programmes that reach the Slovak branch are disclosed here in English before any Slovak communication.

source_name: J&T Finance Group SE — For Investors
why_relevant: Former owner of 365.bank / Postova banka and current owner of J&T Banka's Slovak branch. As a bond issuer it publishes English consolidated annual reports naming statutory bodies and describing group restructuring — the counterparty view of the KBC deal and of what J&T retains in Slovakia.

source_name: J&T Global Finance (bond issuance vehicles) — annual reports
why_relevant: Financing SPVs whose English annual reports disclose group structure changes and guarantor composition; an indirect but legally compelled window on J&T's Slovak perimeter after the 365.bank sale.

source_name: OTP Group — investor news archive
why_relevant: OTP exited Slovakia (sale of OTP Banka Slovensko to KBC, agreed Feb 2020, closed 27 Nov 2020), so this is now a historical/baseline source rather than a live channel. Keep on low-frequency watch in case of re-entry or CEE reshuffles touching Slovakia.

source_name: Slovenská sporiteľňa — English newsroom (subsidiary mirror of group release)
why_relevant: Subsidiary-side English mirror of Erste group announcements; publishing-time comparison between slsp.sk/en, slsp.sk/sk and erstegroup.com establishes the empirical lead-time of the parent channel — the core hypothesis of this cell.

source_name: VÚB banka — international presence / group leadership page
why_relevant: Slovak-language subsidiary page describing VUB's place inside the Intesa Sanpaolo group and leadership framing; used to map group terminology (Danube Hub, divizia medzinarodnych dcerskych bank) onto Slovak wording so the English parent feed can be joined to sk-language reporting.

source_name: MarketScreener — issuer profiles and board rosters (Tatra banka, KBC, Erste)
why_relevant: Aggregator carrying board-member rosters for Tatra banka (SK1110001502 is listed on BSSE) plus mirrored group presentations. Useful as a cheap diffable roster and as a fallback when a parent PDF is paywalled or moved.

source_name: Prague Stock Exchange (PSE) — Erste Group dual listing page AT0000652011
why_relevant: Erste Group is dual-listed in Prague; the exchange page aggregates issuer announcements in English and gives a second, independent publication venue for regulated news relevant to the CEE/Slovak segment.

source_name: EuropaWire — EU press-release distribution (bank group releases)
why_relevant: Carries verbatim English copies of Erste Group releases about Slovak subsidiary appointments and CEE divisional leadership (e.g. the Slovenska sporitelna CEO succession and a 2026 Central-Europe corporate-division head appointment), giving a searchable secondary index.

source_name: Erste Group Annual Report — Strategy & segment reporting (online edition)
why_relevant: Annual report segment chapters give the auditable Slovakia baseline: employees, branches, segment result and organisational structure. This is the denominator against which any announced headcount programme should be measured.

source_name: NBS – Subjekty finančného trhu (supervised-entity register, incl. payment institutions & ATM operators)
why_relevant: Authoritative NBS register listing payments-ecosystem legal entities with SK licences/registrations, including Euronet Services Slovakia (entity 4440) and Trust Pay (entity 3470). Entity records carry statutory representatives and registration dates, so changes reveal country-level org and leadership moves in the payments population that never appear in bank newsrooms.

source_name: NBS PSD2 register JSON API
why_relevant: Machine-readable feed of SK PSD2-authorised providers (AISP/PISP/PIISP) with activity start/end dates. New entrants and exits are leading indicators of payments-employer arrivals and wind-downs in Slovakia.

source_name: FinStat.sk – SK company financials, headcount bands and name history
why_relevant: Aggregator giving employee-count bands, revenue trends and historical company names (e.g. Nexi Central Europe ← SIA Central Europe; DIEBOLD NIXDORF s.r.o. ← WINCOR NIXDORF s.r.o.). Headcount-band movement is a proxy for Bratislava hub expansion or shrinkage when no announcement exists.

source_name: Register účtovných závierok (registeruz.sk)
why_relevant: Official filings repository; annual reports of SK payments entities carry average employee counts and narrative notes on restructuring — a hard, free alternative to paid aggregators for hub-size trajectory.
